# Infrastructure MCP connectors

32 infrastructure connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

The links open the setup guide for each connector and assistant on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All infrastructure connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/infrastructure](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/infrastructure).
